left_out: lifespa.com: its robots.txt has a group for ClaudeBot with 'Disallow: /', so his own site was skipped (blocked) and nothing was read there.

Eat Wheat: its subtitle claims 'A Scientific and Clinically-Proven Approach to Safely Bringing Wheat and Dairy Back Into Your Diet', a claim to resolve food intolerance; still out. Its ISBNs were seen only in search results, not on a page I read.

Perfect Health for Kids: Ten Ayurvedic Health Secrets Every Parent Must Know (PRH page, ISBN 9781556434778): the description covers spotting 'signs of imminent illness' in children and stocking 'useful natural medicines' at home; read as home treatment of children's illness, so left out under the no-replacing-medical-care rule.
The Colorado Cleanse: detox programme; only on his own (blocked) site, so not checked.
The 3-Season Diet and The Yoga Body Diet: diet books, outside scope (left out on review, 12 Nov 2026)
flags: The 3-Season Diet: ISBN 9780609805435 from https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/42408/the-3-season-diet-by-john-douillard-author-of-body-mind-and-sport/ (Harmony, 2001), converted to ISBN-10 0609805436; not confirmed elsewhere.
